name: Mountainview Montessori Elementary
description: Public Montessori elementary school operated by the Surrey School District (SD 36). Recorded only so that it is not re-added: public Montessori programmes are outside the private-school scope.

legal_status.label: Public school (School District 36 Surrey)
legal_status.authority: Board of Education of School District No. 36 (Surrey)

attributes.qualifying_reason: Public school (SPEC §7 explicit exclusion: public alternative programmes, even when Montessori). The B.C. register also lists Eagle Harbour Montessori (SD 45 West Vancouver), Polaris Montessori (SD 57 Prince George) and Don Titus Montessori (SD 59) as public — all excluded on the same ground.
